newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai steel firm to start 500,000T mill end-July.
newsitem.headline: Thai steel firm to start 500,000T mill end-July.

text.p: Thai Special Steel Industry Plc (TSSI) president Anurat Kongtoranin said on Thursday the company's 500,000 tonne-per-year wire rod mill will start up by the end of July.
Anurak told Reuters that the two-billion baht ($76.9 million) project was expected to produce 400,000 tonnes of wire rod within 12 months of the start-up.
"And we will run at full capacity within 24 months following the start-up," he said in an interview.
He said the project was one-and-a-half months behind schedule due to delays in machinery supply.
TSSI, a unit of TPI Polene Plc, operates Thailand's first fully-integrated steel plant, in the eastern province of Rayong.
The wire rod mill is a part of its 25-30 billion baht project to be fully operational in 1999.
The company plans to launch an initial public offer late in the second quarter of this year.
"However, it all depends on the market's mood. But we hope to do so within this year," Anurat said.
